directive.quote: Port the correct parts one to one. Drop only the hard-coded hosts, labels and paths; those become input DATA.

old_copy.deleted_with: the one deletion pull request of the old door files, with scripts/portable-service-host-setup.sh and test/portable-service-connection.test.mjs

preserve: both ends of the forward are 127.0.0.1, the host key is checked against the pinned file, SSH runs in batch mode and exits when the forward cannot be attached
the first host key is kept and an existing pin is never rescanned or replaced
the held key reaches SSH only through a private ssh-agent the run starts and closes; it is never written to a file or argv
a credential that is not an RSA private key is refused before SSH starts
each new connection asks for the credential again, waits two seconds after one ends, and an abort ends the running SSH process
the server's service user may only listen on 127.0.0.1 at its one port: no shell, no session, no other forwarding
administration reaches the same pinned host as root with its own identity, and refuses without one
the launch agent keeps the command running with KeepAlive and a 10 second throttle, and install boots out the old agent before bootstrapping the new one
allowed_deltas: the held key comes on descriptor 4 (a row's credential_mounts fd, or the launch agent's pipe from the vault command the configuration names), not by importing the older owner's vault reader by a relative path into another repository
the configuration comes on standard input under `serve`, as a Workshop command reads its request
the launch agent's label, its vault command and its environment are the installer's input, not a fixed label and a fixed PRODUCT_DATA_ROOT setting; its log is named after the configuration file

administration checks only the address and pinned-host file it uses (not the tunnel's user and ports), and reaches the host through a run's proxy when it has one (proxied: a CONNECT tunnel of the engine's loopback proxy and a 30 second keepalive), taken from renew-a-tls-certificate's port of the same lines so there is one administrationArguments
the connection key's comment and the agent folder's name prefix are given or neutral, not the product's name

the server setup keeps only the tunnel's part (the service user, its key and its sshd block, named after that user); the build host's packages, swap and Rust toolchain belong with the receptionist build, not the tunnel
banned_substitutions: a key written to a file, an environment variable or argv
a host key accepted without the pinned file
a forward that listens beyond the server's loopback
